title: Free day in Cusco

weather.note: Classic Cusco; bright sunny ~21°C, cold once the sun dips. Great for a high hike — start early, layer up.

glance: Your one truly flexible day. Big-adventure option (Rainbow Mountain, Humantay), a wildlife-and-art half-day on the Pisac road, or a relaxed art-market-and-café crawl through San Blas — a lighter day here is smart before Titicaca.

picks.name: Palcoyo Rainbow Mountain
picks.note: Quieter, easier alternative to Vinicunca; three rainbow ridges, less crowd. Long day at altitude.

picks.name: Humantay Lake
picks.note: Turquoise glacial lake below a snow peak; gorgeous, a real leg-burner.

picks.name: San Blas artisan quarter
picks.note: Cobbled galleries & workshops; Casa Mérida ceramics, Mendívil figures, the 7 Angelitos alley.

picks.name: ChocoMuseo
picks.note: Bean-to-bar chocolate workshops and a pisco/coffee/chocolate tasting; fun and hands-on.

picks.name: Cochahuasi Animal Sanctuary
picks.note: Family-run rescue for Andean condors, spectacled bears, pumas and vicuñas; the ticket funds the release program. On the Pisac road, so it pairs with Awana Kancha.
picks.address: Cochahuasi Animal Sanctuary, Km 22 Cusco–Pisac road, Cusco

picks.name: Awana Kancha
picks.note: Llamas, alpacas, vicuñas and guanacos you can feed, plus live weaving. A quick stop on the same road out.

picks.name: Museo de Arte Precolombino (MAP)
picks.note: If you'd rather stay in town: Larco's sister collection in a beautiful mansion, with MAP Café in the courtyard.
picks.address: Museo de Arte Precolombino, Plazoleta Nazarenas 231, Cusco
